hints.title: The Constraint Secret
hints.text: Look at N: N is between 1 and 12. Whenever N <= 15 and the problem asks to visit all nodes, think BITMASK DP or Multi-source BFS with Bitmask. 2^12 = 4096. Total states = 12 * 4096 ≈ 4.9 * 10^4.

hints.title: BFS State Representation
hints.text: Why BFS? Because edge weights are all 1! In an unweighted graph, standard BFS finds the shortest path. We want the shortest steps to reach mask = (1 << n) - 1. Queue elements should be: (node, bitmask, distance).

hints.title: Multi-Source Initialization
hints.text: The problem states you can START at ANY node! So initialize the BFS queue by pushing (i, 1 << i, 0) for every node i from 0 to n-1. Visited set will record (node, mask).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
